description_expanded: Turn up the fun at Here At Last, a gorgeous Gulf-front home in Navarre Beach! With a private pool, just steps from the beach and near shopping, dining, and more, you just found the ultimate coastal getaway! Here At Last is a beautiful two-story home with five bedrooms and four baths accommodating up to fifteen. Featuring generous-sized rooms, elegant decor, and unparalleled views of the Gulf of Mexico, this gorgeous home is the perfect retreat for your coastal getaway. Hardwood flooring throughout and cozy furnishings welcome you inside, filled with floor-to-ceiling windows and brimming with natural light. The living room is the perfect mix of casual elegance and functional design, creating a welcoming space for relaxing and socializing. Take in gorgeous views from the beautifully appointed kitchen with everything needed to prepare your favorite snacks for the beach. Enjoy meals at the dining room table, at the breakfast bar with seating for five, or take it outdoors. Grill up the day’s catch on the private grill, then dine under the stars on the balcony overlooking the Gulf of Mexico. Everyone is assured a peaceful night’s stay with cozy bedrooms and room for a crowd. The mast suite features a king-sized bed with an en suite bath, flat-screen TV, and access to the private balcony. Two additional guest suites feature king-sized beds, while two bunk rooms ensure the kids have their own cozy retreats when the day comes to an end. After lazy days poolside, get out and check out Navarre Beach, featuring the longest fishing pier in the Gulf of Mexico. Dine on locally caught seafood and burgers at Windjammers or enjoy a cocktail while watching the sunset at Juana’s Pagodas and Sailor’s Grill. Browse the Saltwater Cottage for unique keepsakes or hit the Gulf Breeze Zoo, and no trip to Navarre Beach is complete without a trip to Tommy’s Snoballs for refreshing shaved ice and spicy cajun boiled peanuts! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. Please note: 5-car parking driveway - no parking in the garage and boats and RVs are not permitted. The bikes on property are the owner's personal bikes and are not included in the rental.
